metrics.profile_summary: MBA-qualified marketing leader with over 10 years of experience in brand building and digital strategy. Proven track record of scaling 20+ brands and managing high-value client accounts across diverse global and regional markets.

experience.description: Launched 20+ brands, generated $45K+ in quarterly upsells, and built sales and production teams with operational SOPs.
Developed content strategies and brand narratives to drive consistent engagement and account growth.
Led performance marketing and ORM for US-based clients, achieving $8,000 in marketing upsells through service expansion.
Managed integrated digital campaigns for major brands and retained PKR 2.5 Cr+ in annual revenue.
Led SMM team operations and digital strategy for 10+ clients across banking, retail, and entertainment.
Managed brand communications and coordinated with creative teams across multiple business verticals.
Executed brand campaigns for global names including Pepsi, Reckitt Benckiser, and L'Oréal.
Supported B2B business development and client outreach.

strengths: 10+ years of experience exceeding the 5-7 year requirement
Proven leadership of teams and agencies
Expertise in integrated campaigns for global consumer brands (Pepsi, L'Oréal)
Strong technical proficiency in GA4 and ad platforms
weaknesses: No explicit mention of managing a total departmental budget P&L, though ad budget optimization is noted
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match, possessing the required MBA, extensive leadership experience, and a proven track record of managing integrated campaigns for high-profile consumer brands. He meets all must-have technical requirements (GA4, Ad platforms) and is based in Karachi.
